INSERT INTO totd_queue (translatable_id, sort_key)
                SELECT $1::uuid, hashtextextended($1::uuid::text || c.seed, 0)
                FROM totd_queue_config c
                ON CONFLICT (translatable_id) DO UPDATE
                    SET scheduled_date = NULL,
                        assigned_by = NULL,
                        assigned_at = NULL,
                        is_auto = false
